blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Prove the following identities: \(\dfrac{\sin 3x - \sin x}{\cos x - \cos 3x} = \cot 2x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh fraction hai jis ke upar aur neeche dono jagah do trig ratios ka farq hai. Aise sawalon ka asool simple hai: sum ya difference ko product bana do, kyunke product mein common factor nazar aata hai aur cancel ho jata hai.
Saabit kya karna hai? L.H.S. \(= \cot 2x\).
Plan: numerator aur denominator dono ko product banayein, common factor cancel karein, aur \(\frac{\cos}{\sin} = \cot\) pehchanein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin 3x - \sin x}{\cos x - \cos 3x}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \cot 2x\).
Tareeqa: Sum-to-product formulas
\[\sin P - \sin Q = 2\cos\tfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\tfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
\[\cos P - \cos Q = -2\sin\tfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\tfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
Pehla upar ke liye, doosra neeche ke liye.

Numerator ko product banayein (\(P = 3x\), \(Q = x\))
\[\sin 3x - \sin x\]
\[= 2\cos 2x\sin x\]
Kyun: Aadha jama \(\frac{3x + x}{2} = 2x\) aur aadha farq \(\frac{3x - x}{2} = x\). "sin − sin" mein cosine aadha jama leta hai.

Denominator ko product banayein (\(P = x\), \(Q = 3x\))
\[\cos x - \cos 3x\]
\[= -2\sin 2x\sin(-x)\]
\[= 2\sin 2x\sin x\]
Kyun: Yahan order \(x\) pehle, \(3x\) baad mein hai, is liye aadha farq \(\frac{x - 3x}{2} = -x\) aaya. Sine odd function hai: \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\). Formula ka minus aur yeh minus mil kar plus ban gaye.
Dhyan dein: Order apni marzi se mat badlein; \(\cos x - \cos 3x\) aur \(\cos 3x - \cos x\) mein sign ka farq hai.

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\cos 2x\sin x}{2\sin 2x\sin x}\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos 2x}{\sin 2x}\]
\[= \cot 2x = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(2\sin x\) upar aur neeche dono mein hai, cancel ho gaya (yeh maan kar ke \(\sin x \ne 0\)). Phir \(\frac{\cos}{\sin}\) ko \(\cot\) kehte hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 15^{\circ}\)
\[\dfrac{\sin 45^{\circ} - \sin 15^{\circ}}{\cos 15^{\circ} - \cos 45^{\circ}}\]
\[\approx \dfrac{0.4483}{0.2588}\]
\[\approx 1.732 = \cot 30^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cot 30^{\circ} = \sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\). Dono sides barabar hain.

blocks.explanation:
Upar sines ka jama, neeche cosines ka jama, aur dono mein angles wohi \(8x\) aur \(2x\) hain. Is liye dono products mein ek hi cosine factor aayega jo cancel hoga.
Saabit kya karna hai? Fraction \(= \tan 5x\).
Plan: dono ko product banayein, \(\cos 3x\) cancel karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin 8x + \sin 2x}{\cos 8x + \cos 2x}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan 5x\).
Tareeqa: Sum-to-product
\[\sin P + \sin Q = 2\sin\tfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\tfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
\[\cos P + \cos Q = 2\cos\tfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\tfrac{P - Q}{2}\]

Naye angles (\(P = 8x\), \(Q = 2x\))
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = 5x\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = 3x\]
Kyun: \(\frac{10x}{2} = 5x\) aur \(\frac{6x}{2} = 3x\). Upar aur neeche \(P\), \(Q\) ek hi hain, is liye angles bhi ek hi.

Dono ko product likhein
\[\sin 8x + \sin 2x = 2\sin 5x\cos 3x\]
\[\cos 8x + \cos 2x = 2\cos 5x\cos 3x\]
Kyun: Upar wale formulas mein angles rakh diye. Dekhein, dono mein \(2\cos 3x\) common hai, yahi cancel hoga.

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin 5x\cos 3x}{2\cos 5x\cos 3x}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin 5x}{\cos 5x}\]
\[= \tan 5x = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(2\cos 3x\) cancel (yeh maan kar ke zero nahi), aur \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\).

Tasdeeq: \(x = 10^{\circ}\)
\[\dfrac{\sin 80^{\circ} + \sin 20^{\circ}}{\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 20^{\circ}}\]
\[\approx \dfrac{1.3268}{1.1133}\]
\[\approx 1.1918 = \tan 50^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Calculator se dono sides barabar aaye.

blocks.prompt: 3 (iii) [printed as (ii)] Prove the following identities: \(\dfrac{\sin A - \sin B}{\sin A + \sin B} = \tan\dfrac{A - B}{2}\cot\dfrac{A + B}{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Wohi tareeqa, bas angles general \(A\) aur \(B\) hain. Upar sines ka farq, neeche sines ka jama.
Saabit kya karna hai? \(\tan\frac{A - B}{2}\cot\frac{A + B}{2}\).
Plan: dono ko product banayein, phir ek hi angle wale ratios ko ikattha kar ke \(\frac{\sin}{\cos}\) aur \(\frac{\cos}{\sin}\) banayein.
Note: kitab ne is hisse ko dobara "(ii)" likha hai; yeh asal mein (iii) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin A - \sin B}{\sin A + \sin B}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan\frac{A - B}{2}\cot\frac{A + B}{2}\).
Tareeqa: Sum-to-product
\[\sin A - \sin B = 2\cos\tfrac{A + B}{2}\sin\tfrac{A - B}{2}\]
\[\sin A + \sin B = 2\sin\tfrac{A + B}{2}\cos\tfrac{A - B}{2}\]

Products ko fraction mein rakhein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\cos\frac{A + B}{2}\sin\frac{A - B}{2}}{2\sin\frac{A + B}{2}\cos\frac{A - B}{2}}\]
Kyun: Yeh seedhe do formulas hain, \(P = A\) aur \(Q = B\) ke saath. Is dafa koi common factor cancel nahi hota, lekin regroup karne se jawab ban jata hai.

2 cancel kar ke regroup karein
\[= \dfrac{\sin\frac{A - B}{2}}{\cos\frac{A - B}{2}}\cdot\dfrac{\cos\frac{A + B}{2}}{\sin\frac{A + B}{2}}\]
Kyun: Fractions ko multiply karte waqt numerators aur denominators ko kisi bhi order mein jor sakte hain. Humne \(\frac{A - B}{2}\) wale do ratios ek saath rakhe aur \(\frac{A + B}{2}\) wale do ek saath.

tan aur cot pehchanein
\[= \tan\dfrac{A - B}{2}\cot\dfrac{A + B}{2}\]
\[= \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\sin}{\cos} = \tan\) aur \(\frac{\cos}{\sin} = \cot\).
Dhyan dein: Angles aapas mein mat badlein: \(\tan\) ke saath \(\frac{A - B}{2}\) aur \(\cot\) ke saath \(\frac{A + B}{2}\).

Tasdeeq: \(A = 90^{\circ}\), \(B = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\dfrac{1 - \tfrac{1}{2}}{1 + \tfrac{1}{2}} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\tan 30^{\circ}\cot 60^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{1}{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides \(\frac{1}{3}\) aaye, is liye identity sahi saabit hui.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\dfrac{\sin A - \sin B}{\sin A + \sin B} = \tan\dfrac{A - B}{2}\cot\dfrac{A + B}{2}\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is sawal ke hisson ke label (i), (ii), (ii), (iv) chhape hain: teesre hisse ko dobara "(ii)" likha gaya hai aur (iii) ghayab hai. Yahan hum isay sahi taur par (iii) keh rahe hain. Identity khud bilkul sahi chhapi hai, sirf label ki ghalti hai.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (ii) jaisa hi hai, bas angles numbers mein hain. Jab bhi upar sines ka jama aur neeche usi angles ke cosines ka jama ho, jawab tan ban jata hai.
Saabit kya karna hai? Fraction \(= \sqrt{3}\).
Plan: dono ko product banayein; \(\cos 20^{\circ}\) cancel hoga aur \(\tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\) bachega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{\sin 80^{\circ} + \sin 40^{\circ}}{\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 40^{\circ}}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \sqrt{3}\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin P + \sin Q\) aur \(\cos P + \cos Q\) formulas, \(P = 80^{\circ}\), \(Q = 40^{\circ}\). (Kitab ne degree ke nishan chhote primes ki tarah chhape hain; matlab degrees hi hai.)

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{120^{\circ}}{2} = 60^{\circ}\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{40^{\circ}}{2} = 20^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Aadha jama \(60^{\circ}\) ek standard angle hai, is liye aakhir mein exact value milegi. Isi liye sawal mein \(80^{\circ}\) aur \(40^{\circ}\) chune gaye hain.

Dono ko product likhein
\[\sin 80^{\circ} + \sin 40^{\circ} = 2\sin 60^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 40^{\circ} = 2\cos 60^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Sum-to-product formulas; dono mein \(2\cos 20^{\circ}\) common hai.

Divide kar ke cancel karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{2\sin 60^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}}{2\cos 60^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}}\]
\[= \tan 60^{\circ}\]
\[= \sqrt{3} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(2\cos 20^{\circ}\) zero nahi, cancel ho gaya. \(\frac{\sin 60^{\circ}}{\cos 60^{\circ}} = \tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\). Table ya calculator ki zaroorat hi nahi pari.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[\dfrac{0.9848 + 0.6428}{0.1736 + 0.7660} = \dfrac{1.6276}{0.9397}\]
\[\approx 1.732 = \sqrt{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\), dono sides barabar.
